berkas_pengajuan_generated_state_check.name: berkas_pengajuan_generated_state_check
berkas_pengajuan_generated_state_check.value:
(
        ("berkas_pengajuan"."status" = 'SELESAI'
          and "berkas_pengajuan"."generated_pdf_pathname" is not null
          and "berkas_pengajuan"."generated_pdf_size_bytes" is not null)
        or
        ("berkas_pengajuan"."status" <> 'SELESAI'
          and "berkas_pengajuan"."generated_pdf_pathname" is null
          and "berkas_pengajuan"."generated_pdf_size_bytes" is null)
      )

berkas_validasi_ttd_state_check.name: berkas_validasi_ttd_state_check
berkas_validasi_ttd_state_check.value:
(
        ("berkas_validasi"."ttd_pathname" is null
          and "berkas_validasi"."ttd_mime_type" is null
          and "berkas_validasi"."ttd_size_bytes" is null
          and "berkas_validasi"."ttd_uploaded_at" is null)
        or
        ("berkas_validasi"."ttd_pathname" is not null
          and "berkas_validasi"."ttd_mime_type" is not null
          and "berkas_validasi"."ttd_size_bytes" is not null
          and "berkas_validasi"."ttd_uploaded_at" is not null)
      )

metode_kerja_pic_target_check.name: metode_kerja_pic_target_check
metode_kerja_pic_target_check.value: (("metode_kerja_pic"."sub_kategori_id" is not null)::int + ("metode_kerja_pic"."item_id" is not null)::int) = 1

template_forms_source_integrity_check.name: template_forms_source_integrity_check
template_forms_source_integrity_check.value:
(
        ("template_forms"."source_type" = 'link'
          and "template_forms"."file_url" is not null
          and "template_forms"."blob_pathname" is null)
        or
        ("template_forms"."source_type" = 'upload'
          and "template_forms"."file_url" is null
          and "template_forms"."blob_pathname" is not null
          and "template_forms"."file_name" is not null)
      )
